title: Le faux casting de James Bond  (The Fake James Bond Casting)

segments.t: They decide to use actress Linda Gérard to pose as the legendary James Bond casting director and trick Fabrice into believing his agent failed him. Listen to the scene in French first. Don't worry about catching every word. Let's listen to the scene in French first.

Elle parle parfaitement anglais avec l'accent.

D'accord, mais restons très discrets.

'Let's make him believe Bréhier missed this contract.' Gabriel proposes inventing a story about a failed negotiation. In French, this is quite common.

'She speaks English perfectly with the accent.' Gabriel highlights her authentic background using a clear cognate. A common chunk in French.
